Class EyeCheck

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.vision.EyeCheck
public final class EyeCheck extends Object
Measures how well the drawn picture (SyntheticEye) matches the real one. During training and play the opponent is on the real screen; drawing the same moment again and comparing the two shows, in numbers from the user's own game, whether a fighter given the drawn picture sees what it saw on the screen.
